meta.notes: A water mob, a fish: mode swim with water_ambient, swimming in schools of three to six, flopping on land and losing health 300 ticks (15 seconds) after leaving the water. Swimmers move at a movement speed near 1, as fish and dolphins do. It darts away from players within 8 blocks (flee). It spawns in every ocean, in the water (placement in_water, rule water_animal: between 13 blocks below sea level and sea level). msm:animated_model names the model, animation set and texture with renderer auto: GeckoLib draws it where the target has GeckoLib, the runtime's own renderer elsewhere. Export the Fabric mod jar to try it in game.
